title: Welcome to Wondercase
subtitle: Vietnam, Cambodia & Thailand
panel: Home · Maps · Essentials · Gallery · The Group · More
steps: Begin in Hanoi on November 16; the tour ends in Bangkok on December 1.
Follow Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand in the order shown on Home.
This illustrated video has captions. Pause, replay or choose a chapter at any time.

title: Install on your phone
subtitle: Keep your travel companion close
steps: Open the app link in Safari on iPhone or Chrome on Android.
Choose Add to Home Screen (or Install app), then confirm. Browser wording can vary.
Use More → Help & Tutorials for the detailed iPhone and Android videos.

title: Your daily schedule
subtitle: Home is your starting point
panel: Choose a date or use the day arrows
Read the schedule and Xavier’s announcement
Check again before leaving the hotel
steps: Home shows each day’s date, city and schedule. Choose a day with the arrows or calendar.
November 16–20: Hanoi, Hue, Da Nang and Hoi An. November 21–22: Saigon.
November 23–24: Siem Reap and Angkor. November 25–27: Chiang Mai. November 28–December 1: Bangkok. Times can change; follow Xavier’s updates.

title: Explore with Xavier’s maps
subtitle: The big map stays above the city tiles
panel: Tap a city name or marker
Or choose a city tile below
steps: Tap Hanoi, Da Nang, Saigon, Siem Reap, Chiang Mai or Bangkok on the large map to open Xavier’s map.
Angkor Wat opens Xavier’s Siem Reap map. Hue uses its available uploaded map or a Google search.
City tiles below the map offer the same maps and any additional maps Xavier shares.

title: Essentials for the journey
subtitle: Hotels, flights, guides and handouts
panel: Your latest schedule stays on Home
steps: Open Essentials for hotel details, internal flights, local guides and available handouts.
Vedana Lagoon Resort on November 19 is a lunch stop, not an overnight hotel.
Review shared documents online. Download a needed PDF before setting out; current flight and schedule updates take priority.

title: Join our photo gallery
subtitle: Your gallery membership is separate
panel: Already joined: continue into your photos
steps: Tap Gallery. It opens the group’s photo gallery directly.
If you have not joined on this browser, follow the gallery’s Join instructions.
Returning members enter according to the gallery’s saved membership. Safe sign-in does not sign you into the gallery.

title: The Group and meal choices
subtitle: Find your card and select your meals
panel: Choose a meal → submit before its cutoff
steps: Xavier reveals the guest list when it is ready. Your guest card includes Safe and Meal choices links.
Open Meal choices from your guest card and add dietary restrictions or allergies at the top.
Choose the meals Xavier has made visible. Submit each meal or all open meals, and check the confirmation and deadline on each menu.

title: Your private Traveler Safe
subtitle: Use your assigned Safe ID
steps: Open your own guest card’s Safe. Activate your assigned Safe ID with a six-digit PIN on your first visit.
Keep the recovery code somewhere private. Return with your Safe ID and PIN; use recovery if needed.
Save personal PDFs or photos and calendar plans in your Safe. Lock it when finished; downloaded files remain on your device.

title: Discover more
subtitle: History, language and feedback
steps: Open More → Learn More for historical trivia about places on this itinerary.
Choose the Language lessons tile for useful local phrases.
Use Help Wondercase Grow to share feedback. Return on the same browser and device to update it.

title: Help whenever you need it
subtitle: Stay connected and check for changes
steps: The video and printable booklet follow this November 16–December 1 itinerary. They explain app controls, not a fixed promise of activity times.
Internet is needed for updated schedules, Safe content and shared photos. Downloaded PDFs and videos can be opened on your device.
Use The Group for Xavier’s contact details. Never include passwords, invitation links or private documents in feedback.
